ItemID: unavailable; Title: Magic: The Very Best of Olivia Newton-John; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Familiar pop hits fit my recent interest in nostalgic greatest-hits collections.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Photographs & Memories: His Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Jim Croce's melodic storytelling feels like a strong fit alongside Simon & Garfunkel and Jonathan Edwards.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Abba Gold: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for catchy pop songs, given my interest in both older hits and Born This Way.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for songs and familiar voices right now, rather than a relaxing classical collection.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Best of Bonnie Raitt; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Her rootsy sound interests me, but I would choose the older pop and folk collections first today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A traditional roots soundtrack is less appealing today than the pop and folk hits I have been revisiting.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 20th Century Masters: The Millennium Collection - The Best of Lesley Gore; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This fits my interest in mid-'60s pop and compact collections of older hits.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection matches my taste.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Essential REO Speedwagon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my classic-rock listening, but I am more drawn to gentler pop and folk selections this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: We Wish You A Merry Christmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Christmas music fits my latest listening, but I would want to know the performers before choosing this collection.
